material.acceptance_criteria: a CI reload that reorders two kinds keeps each unit only when its kind name is unchanged, and drops the rest; the job prints the dropped count.
material.description: carry_live_units matches kinds by catalog index (room.rs carry path). If a reload reorders the catalog, a unit can be kept with the wrong type. Compare kind names through the catalog.
material.resolution: The carry keeps a unit only when its kind name is unchanged in the new catalog, and counts the rest as refused. CI prints carry kind match ok kept=30 dropped=0. The drop branch is not exercised by the job (follow-up gap-carry-drop-branch-exercised).
material.subject: Match carried units by kind name, not catalog index
